fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Dest Range
fields.help: The destination range of outgoing packets that this route applies to.

fields.label: Network
fields.help: The network that this route applies to.

fields.label: Next Hop Gateway
fields.help: URL to a gateway that should handle matching packets.

fields.label: Next Hop Ilb
fields.help: The IP address or URL to a forwarding rule of type loadBalancingScheme=INTERNAL that should handle matching packets.

fields.label: Next Hop Instance
fields.help: URL to an instance that should handle matching packets.

fields.label: Next Hop Instance Zone
fields.help: The zone of the instance specified in next_hop_instance.

fields.label: Next Hop IP
fields.help: Network IP address of an instance that should handle matching packets.

fields.label: Next Hop VPN Tunnel
fields.help: URL to a VpnTunnel that should handle matching packets.

fields.label: Tags
fields.help: A list of instance tags to which this route applies.

fields.label: Params
fields.help: Additional params passed with the request, but not persisted as part of resource payload
